Automated RFQ Processing

Weeks turn into minutes when Synera's agents join the team. These specialist agents collaborate, negotiate trade-offs, and run processes like RFQ generation and cost analysis end to end, the same way every time, with every step logged for your engineers to review.
Following requirements, Synera AI agents can search supplier part catalogues for cost-efficient matches, design, simulate and calculate costs, providing estimates and a bill of processes in seconds.
Customer achievements and proof

Frost & Sullivan’s best practice analysis of Synera describes how we solve engineering siloes with a single platform that integrates more than 80+ CAx and PLM tools and breaks the cost-speed barrier in engineering.
“Synera is reimagining engineering as an AI-native discipline where human creativity is amplified by autonomous digital teammates, changing how products are conceived, developed, and commercialized.”

NASA deploys multiple Synera AI agents that transform requirements into validated part designs. A supervisor agent interprets goals and requirements, while specialized agents handle optical design, mechanical layout, harnessing, structural validation, and reporting.
"Accelerate development and unlock game-changing performance improvements."

A Project Manager agent receives the RFQ package and coordinates specialist agents through evaluation, concept generation, and costing. IMS Gear now processes the same volume of quotes with one engineer instead of two, and has run 100+ quotes through the system.

Building this in-house means building and maintaining every connector, a security model your IT team will sign off on, and a geometry engine, before a single workflow runs. Synera arrives with all three, plus forward deployed engineers who work alongside your team to land the first production use case.
